milestones.label: Online interviews, Edinburgh College of Art applicants only
milestones.source_text: The Edinburgh College of Art page (official, one school of the university) says shortlisted candidates are interviewed online in early to mid April 2027; other schools set their own timetables.

milestones.label: Outcome, Edinburgh College of Art applicants only
milestones.source_text: The Edinburgh College of Art page (official) says all of its applicants hear the outcome by late April 2027.
